Date: 2025-09-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + quick demo request

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the intro to Redwood — we'd like to see a short 30m demo next week to evaluate inference latency/cost controls for a proof-of-concept. Our team is on Pacific time; are you available any day Tue–Thu around 10:00–12:00 PT?

If possible please include a calendar invite with the join link — our IT sometimes strips calendar join-links when forwarded, so a backup direct URL in the body would be helpful.

Attendees: Jordan Park (Eng lead), Sophie Lin (Platform).

Best,
Jordan Park
Head of Platform
EverBuild Analytics

Date: 2025-09-10T10:03:00-07:00

Hi Jordan — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for the details. I can do Tue 9/16 at 10:30 PT or Wed 9/17 at 11:00 PT — does either work?

We typically run 25–30m and include a short Q&A. Which do you prefer: Google Meet or Zoom? If your org blocks embedded Meet links we can default to Zoom and include a passkey in the invite.

I’ll loop in Ben (solutions) to cover pricing/throughput questions. Once you confirm I'll send a calendar invite with both the platform link and the raw URL in the invite body.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference
redwood.inference.com

On Wed, Sep 10, 2025 at 10:03 AM Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference.com> wrote:
> Hi Jordan — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for the details. I can do Tue 9/16 at 10:30 PT or Wed 9/17 at 11:00 PT — does either work?
> 
> We typically run 25–30m and include a short Q&A. Which do you prefer: Google Meet or Zoom? If your org blocks embedded Meet links we can default to Zoom and include a passkey in the invite.

Thanks Markus — Wed 9/17 at 11:00 PT works best for us. We prefer Zoom because our calendar forwarding sometimes strips Meet links and we can't risk two-step provisioning.

I accepted the invite you just sent, but when Sophie and I click the event the event body shows a placeholder: "[link removed by client]" and the attached .ics appears to contain an empty join URL. Our admin says forwarding from some vendors triggers a calendar-scrub rule.

Can you resend the invite with a direct Zoom URL in the email body (and an .ics that contains the same Zoom link) so Sophie can add it to her calendar? If you can also include a passcode we can test ahead of time.

Appreciate it — we want to lock this in.

—Jordan

Jordan — sorry about that. Looks like the first invite went out with Google Meet metadata that your mail system stripped. I'm looping Ben and Kim to help ensure the invite and permissions are correct.

I have:
- Created a fresh Zoom meeting and embedded the join URL directly in the message body below.
- Attached a regenerated .ics (everbuild-invite.ics) that contains the same Zoom link.
- Attached a PDF deck (redwood-demo-deck.pdf) so your team can skim beforehand.

Direct Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890?pwd=RbY7-ExamplePasskey
Passcode: 482915
Meeting time: Wed, Sep 17 2025 11:00 AM PT (30m)

Quick notes for your admin: some GSuite forwarding rules remove "X-ALT-JOIN" metadata from forwarded .ics files. If that happens again, the direct link above should still work. Ben — can you confirm the .ics contains the URL and that there are no organizer-affinity fields that would cause the strip?

Thanks for flagging this. Please let me know ASAP if you still see placeholders and I’ll send a calendar invite from a different domain.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference
